title: गुणस्तरीय शिक्षाका लागि पेसागत विकासको अपरिहार्यता Gunastariya Shikshaka lagi pesagat bikasako apariharyata
nepali: शिक्षकको पेसागत विकासले विद्यार्थी सिकाइ र गुणस्तरीय शिक्षाको विकासमा प्रत्यक्ष भूमिका खेल्छ । शिक्षण पेसालाई सिकाइ सङ्गठनको आधारका रूपमा विकास गर्न पेसागत विकासले सहयोग गर्नुपर्छ । उल्लिखित सन्दर्भका आधारमा यस अध्ययनमा पूर्व सेवाकालीन, सेवाकालीन तालिम, शैक्षिक भ्रमण, शिक्षण सिकाइ प्रोत्साहनमूलक कार्यक्रम, कार्यमूल्याङ्कन, प्रविधिमा पहुँचको विस्तार, नवीन विधि तथा प्रविधि उपयोगका तौरतरिका आदिको चर्चा गरिएको छ । अध्ययनले व्यक्तिगत अभ्यास र संस्थागत दायित्वलाई केन्द्रमा राखेर स्वाध्ययन, आत्ममूल्याङ्कन, खोजअन्वेषण, कार्यमूलक अनुसन्धान, प्राज्ञिक उन्नयनका सन्दर्भमा शिक्षकलाई सबल बनाउँदै लैजाने विषयवस्तुलाई समेटेको छ । यसका साथै बहुभाषिक मुलुकमा सबै भाषाभाषीको सम्मान गर्दै भाषिक न्यायलाई स्थापना गर्नुपर्ने सन्दर्भ, बालमनोविज्ञान र कक्षामा त्यसको असर लगायतका विषयलाई प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ । अध्ययनमा शिक्षकको पेसागत विकासले शिक्षाको गुणस्तरमा पार्ने प्रभावका बारेमा सैद्धान्तिक चर्चा भए पनि कार्यान्वयन र प्रबोधीकरणको तह कमजोर रहने गरेको निष्कर्ष प्राप्त भएको छ । गुणात्मक विश्लेषणमा आधारित यस अध्ययनमा मूलतः सरकारी निकायबाट प्रकाशित प्रतिवेदन, दस्तावेज लगायतका अन्य सामग्रीलाई मूल सन्दर्भका रूपमा लिइएको छ । पेसागत विकासका लागि नीतिगत पक्ष सबल रहे पनि प्रशासनिक तथा प्रभावकारी शैक्षिक व्यवस्थापन गरिनु अपरिहार्य रहने निष्कर्षका साथमा यो अध्ययन पूरा भएको छ ।
american_english: Teachers' professional development plays a direct role in student learning and the development of quality education. Professional development must assist in developing the teaching profession as the foundation of a learning organization. On the basis of the mentioned context, this study discusses pre-service and in-service training, educational excursions, teaching-learning incentive programs, performance evaluation, expansion of access to technology, and methods and techniques for utilizing innovative methods and technology. Focusing on individual practice and institutional responsibility, the study covers subject matter aimed at empowering teachers in self-study, self-evaluation, exploration and investigation, action research, and academic advancement. In addition, topics such as the context of establishing linguistic justice while respecting all language speakers in a multilingual country, child psychology, and its impact on the classroom are presented. The study concludes that although there is theoretical discussion regarding the impact of teachers' professional development on the quality of education, the levels of implementation and sensitization remain weak. Based on qualitative analysis, this study primarily takes reports, documents, and other materials published by government agencies as its main references. The study concludes with the finding that even though the policy aspect for professional development is strong, administrative and effective educational management remains indispensable.

informal_english: Teachers' professional development plays a direct role in student learning and developing quality education, so it does. Professional development has to help build up the teaching profession as the foundation of a learning organisation. Taking that context as a starting point, this study discusses pre-service and in-service training, educational trips, teaching and learning incentive programmes, performance appraisal, expanding access to technology, and ways of putting innovative methods and technology to work. Keeping individual practice and institutional responsibility at the centre, the study covers subject matter to empower teachers in self-study, self-evaluation, research and enquiry, action research, and academic advancement. Alongside that, topics like establishing linguistic justice while respecting all language speakers in a multilingual country, child psychology, and its effect in the classroom are presented. The study finds that although there is plenty of theoretical discussion about how teacher professional development impacts education quality, the actual levels of implementation and sensitisation remain fairly weak. Based on qualitative analysis, this study primarily takes reports, documents, and other materials published by government agencies as its main references. The study wraps up concluding that even though the policy side of professional development is sound, having proper administrative and effective educational management in place remains completely indispensable.
